title: GTA 6 has more than 170 animal species
yt_title: GTA 6 has 170+ animal species 🐊 Which did you meet first?
description: Over 170 animal species live in GTA 6: Rockstar says Leonida has more than 170 animal species: about 60 birds and over 30 land mammals, plus fish and reptiles (Rockstar via Game Informer, reported by GameSpot). Tip: petting dogs and cats boosts your Focus (Kotaku, GamesRadar, which ties it to the Professional profile). Hunting reportedly rewards clean shots that keep the carcass pristine (unconfirmed). No spoilers. Which animal did you meet first? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (unconfirmed): hunting details (clean shots keep the carcass pristine for a buyer) come from wiki-style guides.

lines.text: Over 170 animal species live in GTA 6. Which one will you meet first?
lines.headline: 1/5 · WILDLIFE

lines.text: About 60 of them are birds, and more than 30 are land mammals, plus fish and reptiles.
lines.headline: 2/5 · THE MIX

scene.title: Of 170+ species
scene.note: Plus fish and reptiles · Rockstar via Game Informer

lines.text: In Rockstar's screenshots, you can spot iguanas in the Keys, alligators in the swamp, deer in the woods, and tropical fish.
lines.headline: 3/5 · WHO YOU'LL MEET

lines.text: Here's a tip: petting dogs and cats boosts your Focus. Just hold the left trigger near them first.
lines.headline: 4/5 · PET TIP

scene.title: Pet them
scene.sub: Hold L2 / LT · tied to the Professional profile

lines.text: And hunting reportedly rewards clean shots: a head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine for a buyer.
lines.headline: 5/5 · HUNTING?
